visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a baseball field during the day. A pitcher in a black and white uniform (number 55) is on the mound, facing a batter in a white, red, and blue jersey. A catcher and umpire are positioned behind the plate. The background is an outdoor stadium with blue walls featuring various brand logos. (2) The pitcher throws the ball, and the batter swings, making contact. The camera pans rapidly to follow the ball flying toward the left-field wall. An outfielder in a black jersey chases the ball. (3) The ball hits the blue padded wall beneath a white logo. The batter runs quickly toward first base and continues to second. Players in the dugout, wearing similar jerseys, are seen cheering and waving their hands in celebration. (4) Close-up shots show the batter, identified as number 58, reaching second base and smiling. He wears a black helmet with a skull decal and blue batting gloves. (5) Slow-motion replays of the hit are shown with graphic overlays for the '2025 Sun Star' event. The batter is seen adjusting his helmet and talking to a fielder while standing on the base bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Two male speakers provide rapid, excited commentary over a constant upbeat electronic pop background track. The overall energy is high, typical of a sports broadcast. (2) A sharp 'clack' sound of a bat hitting a ball triggers a surge in the commentators' volume and pitch. They yell with excitement as a crowd cheer swells in the background. (3) Continuous applause and cheering from a large group of people merge with the music. One commentator laughs while describing the base-running action. (4) The voices transition into a more relaxed, conversational style, discussing social media and video platforms while the background music remains steady. (5) Periodic synthesized 'whoosh' sounds mark graphic transitions on the screen while the dialogue remains continuous.
